name: A smuggler's brass compass
text: A pocket compass in a dented brass case, a name scratched off the lid. Found with a quarryman's cache.

name: A ship's bell
text: A bronze bell with a drowned ship's name cast round it, brought up from a wreck.

name: A ship's side lantern
text: A brass side lantern, its green glass gone milky, grappled up from an old wreck nobody remembers.

name: A quarryman's pick
text: A stonecutter's pick with a hickory handle worn smooth, from a quarry that shut in '93.

name: A captain's pocket watch
text: A gold hunter-case watch, stopped at ten past four, from the strongbox of a schooner that went down off Long Island in '86.

name: A lighthouse lens prism
text: A glass prism from a Fresnel lens, heavy as a brick, that throws the light in colors across a table.

name: A glass net float
text: A green glass ball in a twine net, the kind a gill net hangs from. This one came up in a net nobody set.

name: A fur-trade medal
text: A worn silver medal from the old fur-trade days at La Pointe, dug from under a cairn.

name: A keeper's spyglass
text: A brass telescope with a light-station's mark on the barrel. Some keeper is short one.

name: A rival's nameboard
text: The carved and gilded nameboard off a copycat's schooner, the last that'll be seen of her.

name: A smuggler's dark lantern
text: A tin lantern with a sliding shutter, for showing a light to one boat and nobody else. Dug up at the foot of a dead lighthouse.

name: A ship's chronometer
text: A marine chronometer in its brass-bound box, brought up by hand from a wreck too deep for any grapple. The box kept the water out; it still ticks when wound.
